no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Intercure (Canndoc) is a vertically integrated commercial-stage medical cannabis cultivator and distributor (Israel's largest licensed producer of GMP medical cannabis). It markets pharma-grade cannabis products commercially and is not a clinical-stage drug developer. Investigator-sponsored trials and academic collaborations using Canndoc cannabis oil exist (e.g., NCT05212493 P3 in pediatric ASD, COMPLETED 2021), but these are partner-led IST studies with academic sponsors, not Canndoc-sponsored regulatory development of a defined drug candidate. November 2025 Cannasoul collaboration adds early-stage research focus but no current Phase 1-3 INCR-sponsored clinical assets are disclosed.
